World’s Toughest Mudder

A timed obstacle course endurance event in which distance depends on completed laps.

Belvoir Castle · 26–27 June 2027 · 24 hours

Obstacle enduranceTeam option

Organiser information checked 24 November 2026. Dates and rules can change.

The event

The organiser lists 26–27 June 2027 at Belvoir Castle. This is a 24-hour obstacle event, not a fixed-distance race or a two-day stage event. The 2027 entry page lists individual competition and relays for teams of two to four or five to twelve; the larger relay category is not eligible for podium prizes. Check the final competition rules when published.

Prepare

Build running and walking endurance alongside obstacle-specific movement and grip practice. Check the current categories, lap rules, support and safety arrangements.
